owner_posts.post_text:
PORTFOLIO PRINTING & BINDING

1. Hardcover Binding (Case Binding)
For a premium portfolio, case binding ensures maximum durability and a flat, professional presentation.

The Core: We utilize a rigid 2mm to 3mm imported greyboard for the cover structure to prevent warping.

The Wrap: The cover design is printed on a 130 GSM to 150 GSM liner, which is then tightly wrapped and glued over the board.

The Spine: Can be crafted as a square spine or a rounded spine depending on the page count. For portfolios, a square spine delivers a sleek, modern look.

2. Inside Pages: 170 GSM Imported Stock
170 GSM (Grams per Square Meter) is an ideal "sweet spot" weight for high-end portfolio inner pages. It provides a heavy, distinctively premium feel without being overly stiff.

Imported Quality: Imported art paper features superior opacity, a ultra-smooth surface profile, and high brightness, ensuring exceptional ink holdout and color accuracy.

Finish Selection:

Matte Coated (Recommended): Eliminates glare, making text highly readable and giving photographic portfolios a sophisticated, editorial look.

Gloss Coated: Makes colors vibrant, high-contrast, and punchy. Excellent for vivid commercial designs or high-saturation imagery.

3. Flyleaf & Endpapers (Passing)
Because the inside pages are 170 GSM, the endpapers (the pages glued directly to the inside of the hard covers) should ideally be a thicker, uncoated stock (around 220 GSM to 250 GSM) to structurally anchor the heavy inner block

HIGH QUALITY CANVAS PRINTING

Canvas printing is the process of transferring digital images or artwork onto a high-quality cotton or polyester fabric using advanced digital printers

Menu Cards for Hospitality Clients


For restaurants, cafés, or events, we create custom menu cards that elevate your clients’ brand experience, offering premium quality and tailored designs for every dining environment.

Posters & Large Format Prints That Demand Attention


Whether for events, advertisements, or exhibitions, we deliver custom posters and large prints that grab attention and help clients promote their brand effectively in any space.

Coffee Table Books That Capture Attention

For clients in need of a luxurious portfolio or brand book, we provide premium coffee table books that bring their story to life with custom designs and high-quality photo printing.

Pamphlets & Flyers That Deliver Results

Perfect for local campaigns, product launches, and promotions, we ensure your client’s pamphlets and flyers stand out with affordable, high-quality prints and fast delivery.

Business Cards That Make an Impact

Your clients rely on you for premium business cards that reflect their brand’s professionalism. We deliver high-quality, customized prints with finishes like embossing and spot UV to impress.

Corporate Brochures That Tell the Brand Story

Brochures are essential for showcasing your client’s brand. We help create vibrant, high-quality brochures that align with their identity and deliver their message clearly, whether for marketing or events.

Standees & Roll-Up Standy

If you are planning an upcoming display, tell me:What is the exact event or location where it will be placed?Do you need it to be easily transportable by flight/car, or will it stay in one place?Do you have ready-to-print artwork, or do you need layout guidance?I can help you pinpoint the exact dimensions and materials for your design.

Magazine Book Printing
Standard Sizes: Popular formats include 8.5" x 11" (standard US letter) and A4 for traditional layouts, or 6" x 9" and Digest sizes for compact, book-like magazines.Paper Stock: Cover pages usually demand heavy stock like 100 lb Gloss Cover to resist wear. Internal pages typically use 80 lb or 100 lb Gloss/Matt Text to balance text clarity and vibrant imagery.Coatings: Protect covers with Gloss  for high shine and scratch resistance, or Matte Lamination for a soft, velvety, premium feel.

featured_reviews.name: Sneh Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Did not have a good experience with PrintStop.
I need high quality plastic business card printed for my business. They had requested access to my canva project for the design file which I had provided. After receiving the business cards I was shocked to see that the colors were not accurate at all. The same design shared with Vistaprint and they had printed the business cards very accurately.
When I escalated with the team, I was told that for better color accuracy CMYK format should have been provided and that color variations are expected.

My argument:
For a business card which represents the brand of a company, the colors have to be 100% accurate and variations should not be accepted. If they need a specific format of file for color accuracy then they should have asked for it upfront. I had to throw the whole batch of cards in the bin and incur a loss of ₹5000+.

Sharing the comparision of card from Vistaprint vs from PrintStop for reference. (Top is Vistaprint and bottom is PrintStop)

featured_reviews.review_text:
Outstanding Service from Mehmood: A Benchmark for Customer Care at Capgemini
I am writing this review with immense gratitude and enthusiasm to recognize the truly exceptional support I received from Mehmood regarding the replacement of a faulty Pebble headset that was part of my welcome kit.
In a large corporate environment like Capgemini, it's often the case that issues with minor items, especially those from a welcome kit, can be overlooked or handled with minimal urgency. I honestly expected a simple "no" or a long, bureaucratic process that would eventually fizzle out. However, Mehmood completely redefined my expectations for internal employee support and set a new benchmark for customer service and dedication.
Perseverance and Unwavering Commitment
What makes Mehmood’s service so extraordinary is his sheer perseverance and commitment. He literally worked on this issue for more than a month, ensuring I received a resolution. From day one until the final delivery, his enthusiasm and focus never wavered. He handled all the follow-ups, navigated the internal logistics, and kept me consistently updated—always maintaining a positive, professional, and genuinely helpful demeanor. There was never a moment where I felt like a burden or that my request was too small for his attention. This level of dedication is incredibly rare and speaks volumes about his character.
